status_contract.rule: An unstarted probe or one missing prerequisites requires not_tested with result/evidence null. Once any prescribed action is attempted but the action, boundary recheck, cleanup or evidence is incomplete, blocked requires result null and non-empty redacted structured evidence. completed requires one of 可用, 受限 or 不可用 plus complete runtime fields and non-empty redacted structured evidence.

permission_probe_conditional_requirement.completed: result_is_可用_受限_or_不可用; evidence_index_is_a_non_empty_redacted_object_and_evidence_is_canonical_deep_equal_to_evidence_index; preconditions_observed_actual_action_actual_result_actual_time_executor_account_role_cleanup_result_verifier_are_non_empty; fallback_verified_is_boolean; 受限_or_不可用_requires_non_empty_limitations_and_fallback_verified_true

result_record_contract.evidence_contract: Evidence is null only for not_tested. blocked and completed require a non-empty evidence_index matching evidence_index_contract, and the same record evidence plus the same-probe on-site structured_evidence_index must be canonical deep-equal to that canonical source. An empty object, scenario fixture or expected value is never evidence.
result_record_contract.redaction_contract: Do not store credentials, authorization URLs, device codes, user identifiers, real resource IDs or full Feishu resource links in this repository template.
